## Summary


The slowest part of a regulatory submission isn’t the science. It’s everything between the science and the submission. Each step from data reception to standardized reporting is a handoff between people and tools, and the resulting delay is costly. Industry benchmarks put even the most efficient sponsors at eight to twelve weeks from lock to filing. Each month spent pre-market carries an opportunity cost of $60 million in NPV.


Phoenix is changing that. By putting AI to work where it belongs (e.g., automating repetitive tasks, providing scientific recommendations, orchestrating workflows), our solutions will transform raw study data into a submission-ready deliverable in under a day. You state the goal. Phoenix asks for context, then recommends and builds the workflow. You adjust and refine. The result is fast, fully inspectable, repeatable, and built on the platform regulators have trusted for decades.


Join us on October 1 or 2 for an exploration of the Phoenix AI roadmap. You’ll get a sneak peek at how plain language prompts will soon offer bursts of speed in the analysis workflow, with no loss of control or quality.

✓ See AI-guided NCA applied to a realistic dataset

## This webinar is ideal for


PK Analysts, Pharmacokineticists, Clinical Pharmacologists, Pharmacometricians, and Biometrics and Regulatory leaders responsible for submission timelines.
